commands.name: dream-rsi
commands.description: Dream-RSI: assess | improve | watch | status | stop | resume

commands.name: skill:dream-rsi
commands.description: Use Dream-RSI to assess a project, start a bounded improvement campaign, or inspect its campaign dashboard.

commands.name: skill:dream-rsi-assess
commands.description: Assess the active project and suggest the best targets for Dream-RSI. Use for `/dream-rsi assess`, "what should I improve?", or requests to inspect a project for measurable opportunities.

commands.name: skill:dream-rsi-improve
commands.description: Run a bounded Dream-RSI campaign that improves a chosen repository, file, project, or idea against a verified goal. Use for `/dream-rsi improve`, or when a user explicitly asks to optimize or improve a target through Dream-RSI.

message:
Dream-RSI · arXiv 2609.14858
  /dream-rsi assess [what you want]  rank project levers (read-only)
  /dream-rsi improve <what you want>  run a verified improvement campaign
  /dream-rsi watch  open the campaign dashboard · Ctrl+Shift+D
  /dream-rsi status | stop | resume  inspect or control the campaign
